execution.input_policy: identical immutable dataset for both algorithms

phases.accuracy_policy: full image-time trajectory; SE3 alignment; report coverage and failures; distinguish loop-corrected trajectory from online odometry

phases.geometry_policy: preserve FOV/aspect ratio or record explicit crop and resize transform; transform camera intrinsics accordingly
phases.image_policy: same lossless grayscale preprocessing for both estimators; preserve camera identities, sequence numbers, raw timestamps and image orientation

metrics.capture_to_pose_latency_ms: live phase only; use a validated common clock and declared exposure-time reference
metrics.playback_to_pose_latency_ms: paced dataset phase; host enqueue to corresponding visual update; not physical exposure latency
metrics.throughput_pairs_per_second: completed visual updates / measured processing wall time
metrics.cpu_usage: sum over all estimator processes; 100 percent means one logical core
metrics.memory_peak_rss_mb: sum over estimator processes with aggregation policy recorded

interpretation.realtime_requirement: bounded queue over complete paced playback; record p95/p99 latency, drops and accuracy
